faqs.q: How do I apply for or renew a Mobility Parking Scheme permit?
faqs.a: You can apply for, replace, or renew a Mobility Parking Scheme permit for an individual using the dedicated link.

faqs.q: Can I apply for an additional Mobility Parking Scheme permit?
faqs.a: Yes, there are separate application links available for both individuals and organisations to apply for an additional permit.

faqs.q: What if I am a pensioner and need a refund?
faqs.a: You can apply for a new pensioner refund on a Mobility Parking Scheme permit.

faqs.q: How do organisations apply for a Mobility Parking Scheme permit?
faqs.a: Organisations can apply for a Mobility Parking Scheme permit using the specific application link for organisations.
